findings.description: The server state probe never reports the lock state of OPEN_INVENTORY (null in all 30 state lines), contrary to the brief's row anatomy. The lock is still provable from count < threshold in the state line, the ability-specific client overlay text and the absence of effect, so verdicts are reproducible, but the server-side excerpt alone does not show the lock state.

The E1 direct site is only set membership (CLIENT_DEPENDENT), and the cited family resolver (findBlockAbility) is unrelated to the inventory key. The actual server-side lock check behind the evidence, BukkitBridgeRuntime.java:304-309 (denial intent accepted only while locked), is not cited in E1.
